name: Toolszu Link Shortener
author: Toolszu

sections.description:
Toolszu Link Shortener connects your WordPress site to your free Toolszu account. Every time you publish, a short link is created in the background, ready to share on social media, in emails or in print.

The short link also becomes the WordPress shortlink of the post. “Copy shortlink”, the rel="shortlink" tag and sharing plugins that read it all use your Toolszu link, while your canonical URL and social preview tags stay exactly as they are, so SEO is not affected.

Features

  • Auto-shorten on publish for the content types you choose (posts and pages by default, plus any public custom post type).
  • Two short domains: biopage.link and myzu.link.
  • Link style: short random codes (aX7b9Q) or readable post names (my-post-name-x7k).
  • Bulk generate: select older posts in the list and pick “Generate Toolszu links” from Bulk actions.
  • Click counts in the editor box, with a link to full statistics in your Toolszu dashboard.
  • One-click copy from the posts list and the editor.
  • Test connection button to check your API key before saving.
  • Safe unlink: remove a link from a post in WordPress without deleting it in Toolszu.
  • Light and fast: no external scripts, fonts or icon libraries are loaded.

Requirements

A free Toolszu account and its API key. Create an account.

External Services

This plugin uses the Toolszu API to create short links and read their click counts.

  • Service: Toolszu API, https://app.toolszu.com/api/
  • When it is used: when a post is published (if auto-shorten is on), when you click Generate or use the bulk action, when you open a post that has a short link (click count, cached for 15 minutes), and when you click Test connection.
  • Data sent: your API key, the post’s permalink, the chosen short code and domain. No visitor data is sent.
  • Terms of Service: https://toolszu.com/terms-and-conditions
  • Privacy Policy: https://toolszu.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Toolszu Link Shortener”, then click Install Now and Activate.
  2. Sign in to your Toolszu dashboard and copy your API key from Account > API.
  3. Open Toolszu Links in the WordPress menu, paste the key and click Test connection.
  4. Pick your short domain, link style and content types, then click Save settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Toolszu account?

Yes. A free account at https://app.toolszu.com/register gives you an API key.

Does this change my canonical or Open Graph URL?

No. The plugin only sets the WordPress shortlink. Search engines and social previews keep using your normal permalink.

How do I create links for older posts?

Go to Posts > All Posts, select the posts, choose Generate Toolszu links from Bulk actions and click Apply. Up to 50 posts are handled per run. You can also click Generate on a single post.

What does Unlink do?

It removes the short link from the post in WordPress only, so you can create a new one. The link itself keeps working until you delete it in your Toolszu dashboard.

Where can I see full statistics?

In your Toolszu dashboard under Links. The editor box shows the click count and a Statistics link.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Its settings and the short links saved on your posts are removed from WordPress. Your links stay in your Toolszu account and keep working.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: the short link is now the WordPress shortlink (rel=”shortlink”, Copy shortlink). Canonical and social URLs are no longer changed.
  • New: click counts in the editor box.
  • New: “Generate Toolszu links” bulk action.
  • New: choose which content types get short links, including custom post types.
  • New: Test connection button.
  • New: Generate button in the editor box.
  • Improved: the saved API key is never shown on the page. Leave the field empty to keep it.
  • Improved: clear error messages from the Toolszu API.
  • Improved: only users who can edit a post can create or unlink its short link.
  • Improved: no external icon library; faster settings page.
  • Improved: settings link on the Plugins page and full clean-up when the plugin is deleted.
  • Fixed: myzu.link was not shown as selected after saving.

1.0.2

  • Added a “Connect With Us” sidebar widget.

1.0.1

  • Updated API endpoint path.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
